title: 6 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Save on your pass before doors open
summary: In 6 days, 10,000+ people from across the global startup and tech ecosystem will come together at San Francisco’s Moscone West for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. If you’re planning to be one of them, don’t wait to register your ticket before prices increase at the door. Save up to $100
reason: TechCrunch Disrupt event ticket promotion; no AI model release, research artifact, industry business event, policy action, or OSS tool. No rule covers it.
